source: Read-only pg_indexes, relevant existing non-constraint indexes. Constraint-backed indexes are already in the R08 fixture. These are local fixture setup, not a migration.
indexes: CREATE INDEX agreements_requester_idx ON public.agreements USING btree (requester_account_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX agreements_worker_idx ON public.agreements USING btree (worker_account_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE INDEX agreement_change_proposals_agreement_status_idx ON public.agreement_change_proposals USING btree (agreement_id, status, created_at DESC)
